about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for manual-br (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The 'Following other guidance' heading and the four body paragraphs printed below Table 1.1 are kept only inside the table's text as if they were table notes, not as their own section.
findings.evidence: source: "Following other guidance It is important to agree with the building control body" / tree: only in table-1-1 text after "NOTES:"

findings.problem: The heading 'Following other guidance' and its four body paragraphs are kept only inside the table's note text, not as a heading and text sections of their own.
findings.evidence: tree table text: "NOTES: ... Following other guidance It is important to agree with the building control body"

findings.problem: Running footers are kept in the table text and as a text section.
findings.evidence: tree: "10 Overview Manual to the Building Regulations" / "Manual to the Building Regulations Overview 9"

findings.problem: The figure caption is joined to the text printed below the figure, and that text comes before the figure's table.
findings.evidence: tree: "Figure 2.1 The building control process Refer to Volume 2, Chapter E for details of approved inspectors' initial notices."

findings.problem: Figure 2.1 (a flowchart) is read as a one-column table titled 'Chapter 2', and its caption is a separate text block joined with the paragraphs printed below the figure.
findings.evidence: source: "Figure 2.1 The building control process" / tree: table title "Chapter 2"

findings.problem: The two closing paragraphs printed after the figure come before the figure content in the tree.
findings.evidence: tree: "Figure 2.1 The building control process Refer to Volume 2, Chapter E for details..."

findings.problem: The flowchart grid drops the Yes/No branch labels, so it does not say which answer leads to which box.
findings.evidence: source: "Do Building Regulations apply to the work? No -> No notification required" / tree: ["Start: Do Building Regulations apply to the work?"], ["No notification required"]

findings.problem: The heading "Is a building control body involved?" is read as the start of the body text.

findings.problem: The flowchart is flattened into a single-column list, so the No branch (building notice) seems to pass through the substantive plan assessment box, which the arrow on the page skips.
findings.evidence: source: arrow from "No" goes straight to "Work may start after..." / tree: rows in sequence after "No: The applicant may deposit a building notice application"

findings.problem: The flowchart's top two boxes are repeated as a separate text section before the table.

findings.problem: The flowchart title and first box are repeated as a separate text section as well as in the table grid.
